name: QR Share
description: A QR code of every page's address, behind a small button or as a card at the bottom, and on printed pages. Generated on your server as inline SVG: no image service, no tracking.

panels.title: QR code
panels.description: A QR code that opens the current page on a phone. It is made on your server; nothing loads from another site.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Show QR codes
fields.description: Turn this off to leave every page exactly as it was rendered.

fields.name: placement
fields.title: Where
fields.description: A round button that opens the code, or a card at the bottom of every page.

choices.title: Card at the bottom of the page

fields.name: side
fields.title: Button side
fields.description: Which bottom corner the button sits in.

fields.name: heading
fields.title: Heading
fields.description: The line next to the code. Leave it empty for no heading.

fields.name: accent
fields.title: Button colour
fields.description: The round button and the download button. The code itself is always black on white, so every phone can read it.

fields.name: print
fields.title: Print the code
fields.description: With the button, also print the code at the bottom of printed pages. Handy for posters and menus.

fields.name: download
fields.title: Download button
fields.description: Lets visitors save the code as an SVG file, sharp at any size.

fields.name: exclude
fields.title: Never on
fields.description: Slugs separated by commas. A trailing * matches a prefix, e.g. "legal/*".

fields.name: site-address
fields.title: Site address
fields.description: e.g. https://example.com. Optional: learned when you publish on a domain. Without an address pages are left as they are.
